key_insight: Humidity reshapes FAPbI₃ phase-transition pathways through competing water uptake by the δ phase and a water-affine metastable intermediate.
engineering_relevance: Understanding moisture-dependent transitions could guide humidity control during perovskite fabrication and moisture protection during solar-cell operation.
method: Large-scale atomistic simulations using an ab initio machine-learned potential
Analysis of a layered metastable intermediate along the Burgers transition pathway
Comparison of water uptake by the intermediate and δ phase
evidence_signal: Simulations reproduce the experimentally observed increase in the δ-to-α transition temperature with increasing humidity.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative accuracy metrics or device-level validation, leaving practical humidity-control targets unresolved.
paper_title: Humidity-modulated Ostwald Step Rule in $\rm FAPbI_3$ Martensitic Transitions
